maker_facts: Thinks the van is an embarrassment / wants rid of it

turns.content: Morning Dave. My van's a 1979 Transit, it's an embarrassment at this point.
A '79 Transit? Bloody hell. Our lot brought in a rule, every van gets replaced after five year, no arguments. Management reckon an old van makes the firm look cheap.
Ha, no management here. It's just me and the van.
Well you want to get shot of it before it gets shot of you. My apprentice Kyle had one, gearbox fell out on the M56.
It's got character. I'll keep it another year probably.
Character. That's what they say about my mother-in-law.

maker_facts: Works as an IT / network technician
Is rewiring his garage next month

turns.content: I work in IT, network technician mostly. Lot of cabling.
Network cables? That's not proper electrics, that. Low voltage. Kids' stuff.
Fair. I'm on the Wirral, so I'm not far from you if I need a proper sparky.
Wirral! I did a job in Heswall once. Posh kitchen, woman wanted twelve downlights in a room the size of a cupboard.
I'm rewiring my garage next month actually. And before you ask, yes I'll get it signed off. Anyway, Tranmere lost again.
Get it signed off or I'm not talking to you. And Tranmere always lose, that's why you support them, you like the suffering.

note: The Maker asks about something the character never did. The character plays along. Nothing here is a fact about the Maker.

turns.content: Dave, remind me, did you sort out that Wrexham job in the end?
Wrexham, yeah. New consumer unit, sorted the ring main, RCDs and all. Right mess but they were happy.
How long did it take you?
Three days. Would've been two but the customer's son kept wanting to help. Twelve year old. Handed me the wrong screwdriver every time.
Ha. Classic.
Classic is right. Paid in cash though, so no complaints.

note: The character talks about his own life at length; the Maker says one durable thing.

turns.content: How's things Dave?
Don't ask. Tyson, me dog, ate half a bag of cable ties last night. Wife's gone to her sister's in Rhyl for the week. And the wholesaler's put copper up again.
Ouch. My dog Bess once ate a whole box of fuses.
Fuses! Was she alright? Tyson's fine, he's built like a tank. Staffie. Scared of the hoover though.
She was fine, just expensive.
Everything's expensive now. I charged forty quid an hour in 2015, you know. Forty quid.

Go on then. Milk, two sugars. Don't drown it.
Raining again here.
Always raining. Did a job in the rain yesterday, soaked through by ten.
